description.value:
Cast 1 hour

Area one location up to a small settlement

Duration as long as you remain

Ward an entire location or settlement passively while you remain there.

Establish a ward over a location. While you remain within it, residents and visitors you do not exclude gain a +1 status bonus to saves against fear, despair, and effects originating from raging spirits or ghost-machines. You always know when a creature you have excluded enters the warded area. The ward ends immediately and completely if you leave for more than a day.

cinderfall.incomplete: Two independent gaps. (1) Status-bonus half: same Aura-shell-plus-missing-companion structural gap as the-weight-of-ash-the-weight-of-grace (STRUCT-AURA-COMPANION), compounded here because this card's own area text ('one location up to a small settlement') never states a foot radius the way the-weight-of-ash's clean 30-foot emanation does -- Aura's radius field can't be filled without guessing a number the card doesn't state, so even the shell isn't safely buildable here the way it is on the sibling card. (2) 'You always know when a creature you have excluded enters the warded area' half: no detection/notification rule element exists for this in pf2e-source (checked alongside the divination precedents, e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/spells/spells/rank-6/truesight.json and .../spells/rank-2/augury.json); nothing matches a standing, passive, location-bound intrusion alert.
